title: fix(ui): announce agent file save failures and conflicts
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: screen readers can miss a failed agent-file save or workspace conflict while the editable draft remains on screen.

## User Impact

User impact: the existing failure and conflict messages are exposed as alerts, including their existing Reload and Overwrite recovery controls. Normal file information stays nonassertive. No file permissions, write ordering, draft handling, focus behavior, or visual layout changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

The file outcome owner already records and displays the failure, but its danger callouts lacked alert semantics. Add the semantics at those existing presentation slots; keep the authoritative owner and recovery paths unchanged.

Whole-diff simplification: no new state, abstraction, listener, or request. Production +6/-2 lines; bundled regression +64 lines reusing the existing fixture. The two new cases protect ordinary failure and the separate retained-conflict branch.

## Evidence

- Bundled production UI: both new failed-save cases fail on base 7559fb21a57059bd7483fb8c0a7117aff9794f92 because the displayed failure has zero alerts; all 6 lifecycle cases pass with the fix. The cases retain a newer edit made during the pending save, preserve usable recovery controls, and clear the alert after successful saving.
- Chromium accessibility snapshots change from ordinary text to an alert. Actual screen-reader speech is not claimed. No focus/overlay implementation changes; no WebKit-specific claim.
- Existing owner/sibling regressions: 41 passed across file status, file owner, draft navigation, and route retirement.
- UI types and UI E2E test types, scoped oxlint, oxfmt, controller guard, English/keyless i18n verification/baseline, and git diff --check passed. No copy/baseline changes.
- Independent Auto Review: accepted scoped-clean at P0–P2, no findings.
- Bundled lifecycle file: 13.54 seconds test time / 39.64 seconds invocation including build; two added cases total 2.18 seconds. The exact-head CI run [39879268998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39879268998) completed successfully, including the planned UI E2E shard, all three UI shards, types, lint, i18n and performance gates.
- Before/after screenshots: inspected synthetic 1440×900 light-theme captures for failed save and conflict; each before/after pair is byte-identical, as expected for a semantics-only fix. All four public asset hashes and dimensions match the inspected originals, and their inline PR rendering was verified.

| State | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Failed save | ![Before: failed agent file save](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d083ff0a-9a4b-4e13-b8d5-21c0397d6c6b) | ![After: failed agent file save exposed as alert](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7846b3c4-ee8b-4f08-93d5-b2b8259ae13c) |
| Workspace conflict | ![Before: workspace conflict](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/52e9d1ab-a1bd-403f-bc21-4f0b1efd56a2) | ![After: workspace conflict exposed as alert](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f107621b-8d5d-47e0-a5dd-a59312244624) |

<details>
<summary>Retained bundled Chromium accessibility-tree output</summary>

Verbatim excerpts from the original runs of the committed test's "announces a failed file save (conflict: false/true) without losing the draft" scenarios; no recapture or test replay. The test records Playwright ariaSnapshot() immediately after the mocked Gateway failure is displayed, before its alert assertion.

**Before:** base production source 7559fb21a57059bd7483fb8c0a7117aff9794f92, original bundled run started 2026-10-23 00:30:37 UTC. Both scenarios failed because the displayed message had zero alerts.

Failed save:

```text
- tabpanel "Files 1":
  - text: Synthetic write rejected; retry Save.
```

Workspace conflict:

```text
- tabpanel "Files 1":
  - text: Synthetic workspace changed; Reload or Overwrite to recover.
  - button "Reload"
  - button "Overwrite"
```

**After:** original candidate bundled run started 2026-10-23 00:32:23 UTC; its production source is byte-identical to subsequently published head 7afba4cddca380e14526b6dfc946846431870993. Both scenarios passed, as did the four existing lifecycle scenarios.

Failed save:

```text
- tabpanel "Files 1":
  - alert: Synthetic write rejected; retry Save.
```

Workspace conflict:

```text
- tabpanel "Files 1":
  - alert:
    - text: Synthetic workspace changed; Reload or Overwrite to recover.
    - button "Reload"
    - button "Overwrite"
```

The same retained editor line appears verbatim in all four snapshots (nonadjacent to the excerpts above), including the edit made while saving:

```text
    - textbox "Content": "# Garden helper Keep these synthetic instructions. A newer edit."
```

This is browser accessibility-tree evidence, not a claim of actual screen-reader speech. The existing Reload/Overwrite controls remain present; the passing candidate scenarios also verify their enabled state and alert clearance after successful saving.

</details>

Requested by Mitchell Etzel (@etzelm).
